lede: Wat Bunkoet accounts for 28 catalogued manuscripts, 22 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phayao (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (96%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (79%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (18%). Dated witnesses run 1902–1938 CE (2 of 28 carry a date).
